auto_start.label: Start Super Productivity automatically
auto_start.description: Starts the desktop app in the background when the companion is unavailable.

launch_method.label: Launch method
launch_method.description: Method Noctalia uses to start or focus Super Productivity.

native_command.label: Native command
native_command.description: Executable name or absolute path that Noctalia uses to launch Super Productivity. Do not include arguments.

bridge_dir.label: Bridge directory override
bridge_dir.description: Optional path to the companion data directory. When empty, Noctalia detects the path automatically.

poll_seconds.label: Refresh interval
poll_seconds.description: How often Noctalia reads the companion state, in seconds.

prefer_tracked_task.label: Show tracked task first
prefer_tracked_task.description: Places the currently tracked task before due tasks while its timer runs.

show_timer_controls.label: Show timer controls
show_timer_controls.description: Shows start and stop tracking controls in the expanded details panel.

sound_on_complete.label: Completion sound
sound_on_complete.description: Plays a sound after Super Productivity confirms task completion.

notify_due.label: Due notifications
notify_due.description: Shows a notification when an upcoming task reaches its due time.

overdue_text_color.label: Overdue text color
overdue_text_color.description: Color used for overdue task text in the bar widget and details panel.

max_upcoming.label: Upcoming task limit
max_upcoming.description: Maximum number of due tasks available when scrolling the widget.

glyph.label: Widget glyph
glyph.description: Icon shown beside the task title.

show_due_text.label: Show due text
show_due_text.description: Shows the relative due time in the bar widget.

max_title_chars.label: Maximum title length
max_title_chars.description: Limits task titles to this number of characters in the bar widget.
